task.title: Ограничить запуск продукта контроля проверками BPM health и readiness
task.shortdesc: Используйте текущие health probes как startup gate перед началом API-синхронизации внешним продуктом контроля.

prereq.p: BPM source deployment уже запущен. Настройте внешний продукт: $BPM_BASE_URL, timeout, polling interval, maximum wait и действие при ошибке gate.

context.p: Процедура использует API-HEALTH-001 и API-HEALTH-002. Probes являются только малыми preflight signals; они не раскрывают authentication, authorization, database diagnostics, schema-cache diagnostics, request IDs или service-level objectives. Этот набор runbook M12-08 явно фиксирует health-gated startup, data ownership, failure recovery и правило do not retry blindly, если evidence устарела.

step.cmd: Проверьте basic liveness перед открытием synchronization queue.

info.p: Пример запроса: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health. Пример ответа: 200 {"status":"ok"}. Transport errors are handled by the external product because no BPM application error body is declared for this probe.

step.cmd: Проверьте readiness перед profile или validation calls.

info.p: Пример запроса: GET $BPM_BASE_URL/health/ready. Пример ответа: 200 {"status":"ready","ready":true}. If ready is not true, hold the queue and do not start mutations.
Сохраните timestamp, base URL label, timeout, probe status, observed body, control-product version, and chosen next action. Не store private hosts in shared runbook examples.

step.cmd: После успешного gate начните с read-only inventory.

info.p: Call GET $BPM_BASE_URL/api/profiles?limit=50 before import, export, validation, or patch operations. This keeps initial synchronization observable and recoverable.

step.cmd: Переходите к mutation workflows только после успешных read-only calls.

info.p: Continue to validate-before-apply, import-review-export, or export workflows according to the external product schedule. Keep retry and backoff policy outside BPM.

info.note: A successful probe does not reserve revisions or guarantee later API success. A failed or ambiguous probe must stop automated mutations until an operator checks logs, source deployment state, and network/CORS boundaries.

result.p: The external control product starts synchronization only when BPM responds to the current health and readiness handshake. Результат фиксируется с теми же API identifiers и evidence boundaries.

postreq.p: If the startup gate fails, use the Administrator/DevOps troubleshooting and source-deployment topics rather than adding undocumented probe assumptions. Следующий шаг выполняется только после сохранения audit evidence.
